g.text: Detected indoor objects (MIT + NYU-Depth) vs the Amazon Home & Kitchen catalogue

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Objects: the 1,068 nodes of the trained co-occurrence graph, verified equal to the default_fixed encoder checkpoint. Items: raw_graph.txt, one label per item, 1,815 distinct — the same file build_object_feat reads.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Tiers are that function's own branch: exact name match, else nearest MiniLM node. The shipped corpus reaches 7,506 items exactly (51.8%) and 5,485 more by proximity (37.8%), leaving 1,512 (10.4%) unreached.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: τ sets only the near/unreached split, never the exact share: 3.9% / 10.4% / 21.1% unreached at τ = 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7.
